title: Join us for the PanKbase Webinar August 20th, 2026
summary: Learn how to Power Your Next Discovery: New Data & Tools in Pankbase!
bodyHtml:
Join us for the next PanKbase Office Hours:
🧬 Power Your Next Discovery: New Data & Tools in Pankbase
📆 Thursday, August 20th, 2026
⏰ 12:00–1:00 PM ET
🎙️ Featured speakers: Anna Gloyn, PhD; Thomas Bate, PhD; Annie Moriondo; Ringo Mao

Topics we will cover:

  1. PanKbase and where we are
  2. Updated donor browser
  3. Islet perifusion functional data browser
  4. PanKgraph natural language search
